rationale: Both prior blocking findings are resolved and confirmed against current source: update_project now validates the effective chargeback_attribution (falling back to the project's persisted value) against the resolved cost_center_id, so clearing a linked cost center without also resetting attribution raises 400 instead of persisting an orphaned cost_center attribution; and chargeback_attribution is now checked against a VALID_CHARGEBACK_ATTRIBUTIONS allow-list before reaching the repository, rejecting any unrecognized value with 400 instead of surfacing an unhandled 500 at the DB CHECK constraint. New tests (test_project_service_chargeback.py) exercise both fixed paths and the full suite passes.

chargeback_attribution is a bare str with no allow-list; only the cost_center branch is validated, so other values skip validation and reach the DB CHECK constraint, surfacing as an unhandled 500 since the PATCH handler does not catch IntegrityError.

finding_status.notes: update_project now computes effective_chargeback_attribution (chargeback_attribution if provided else project.chargeback_attribution) and validates it against resolved_cost_center_id, so clear_cost_center=True without resetting attribution now raises 400 instead of persisting an orphaned cost_center value. Confirmed at project_service.py:213-216 and by test_clearing_cost_center_with_stale_cost_center_attribution_raises_400.

_validate_chargeback_attribution now rejects any value outside VALID_CHARGEBACK_ATTRIBUTIONS ({'project','cost_center'}) with a 400 before the repository call, closing the path to an unhandled 500 at the DB CHECK constraint. Confirmed at project_service.py:311-312 and by test_unrecognized_attribution_value_raises_400_before_repository.
